get.summary: Read a lightweight project window or cursor deltas
get.description: Without after: latest up to 50 visible messages, ascending, near 24 KB of message data. has_older and next_before support scroll-up with before. With after: ascending deltas; has_more and next_after govern delta paging. Only the newest Ready revision per worker is visible. Earlier rows remain exact reply targets and are readable through /api/update-history. Suppressed sources are sent unless visibility_revision matches; evict matching retained assistant messages even if messages is empty. Restored sources trigger a latest-window reload without after. Heavy threads, worker_index and model_last_call are split into revisioned /api/metadata. Polls never wait for remote WAS. Responses negotiate gzip. See tests/FAST_LOADING_QA.md for pagination and cache contracts.

post.description: Body: text, project_id (Space id or unsorted), request_id (stable unique string), optional reply_to (message integer in this project). 202 durable queue receipt, not completion; replay the identical payload safely.

Body: enabled boolean (existing pause), OR front_desk_trial boolean (separate persisted optional trial, default false). Returns fresh state including front_desk_trial. OFF retains the existing model route. Public routing policy is code-owned and cannot be changed through this API. Worker sessions continue when paused.
Body: request_id. Only a failed job may retry. Original side-effect idempotency key is retained.
